# TYFSADIK | MD. Taki Yasir Faraji Sadik

> Personal portfolio of MD. Taki Yasir Faraji Sadik ("Taki Sadik"), a cybersecurity
> and IT infrastructure professional based in North York, Toronto, Ontario, Canada.
> The site documents his work experience, certifications, self-hosted homelab
> infrastructure, a Canadian defence hardware program, and 116 hands-on IT labs.

## Identity

- Professional name: MD. Taki Yasir Faraji Sadik
- Display name: Taki Sadik
- Site handle: TYFSADIK
- Role: Cybersecurity & IT Professional (Data Center Engineer at Microsoft, contract; Senior IT Infrastructure Specialist at Amico Group of Companies, Richmond Hill)
- Research focus: Defence Technology Researcher: builds and documents hobby-scale defence sensing and resilient-systems projects (passive radar, GPS-denied navigation, counter-drone detection, Arctic domain awareness, DDIL networks)
- Location: North York, Toronto, Ontario, Canada
- Contact: taki@tyfsadik.org

## Project collections

- [Canadian Defence Hardware Program](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/defence-hardware-program): eleven hobby-scale sensor and robotics builds mapped to public Defence Drone Initiative and MINERVA requirements
- [Defence software builds](https://tyfsadik.org/work): Arctic domain awareness, DDIL-proof DevOps, counter-drone sensor fusion, decision black box, zero-trust supply chain, LENTUS-style drone mapping
- [Daru](https://tyfsadik.org/work/infrastructure/daru): open-source self-hosted SIEM in one Go binary plus ClickHouse (log search, alerts, incident triage, syslog, audit trail, packet capture)
- [Chakor](https://tyfsadik.org/work/infrastructure/chakor): open-source self-hosted AI workspace
- [Infrastructure and homelab](https://tyfsadik.org/work/infrastructure/kubernetes-infrastructure): 7-node Kubernetes cluster, zero-trust Proxmox cloud, self-hosted AI, DNS, email, storage, photo server, wiki, search engine
- [Homelab Server Room](https://tyfsadik.org/work/infrastructure/homelab-server-room): the physical basement build (racks, switching, power, cooling) behind the cluster

## All projects

### Defence technology research

- [Passive Acoustic Drone Detector](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/acoustic-drone-detector): MEMS microphone array on a Raspberry Pi that detects drone rotor harmonics, rejects birds and aircraft, and estimates direction of arrival by beamforming.
- [Mini Airspace Deconfliction Manager](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/airspace-deconfliction-manager): Small-scale UAS airspace manager: ESP32 tracker beacons, ArduPilot SITL simulated drones, dynamic geofences, predicted-conflict alerts, human override.
- [Arctic Domain Awareness Digital Twin](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/arctic-domain-awareness): Streaming pipeline fusing ADS-B aircraft data, AIS ship tracking, and Sentinel-1 radar imagery over Canada's North, with anomaly detection for dark vessels.
- [Arctic ISR Drone (Cold, Glove-Operable, Thermal, TAK)](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/arctic-isr-drone): Build guide for a cold-weather Arctic ISR drone: Lepton thermal detection on a Hailo accelerator, georeferenced TAK markers, glove controls, honest spec gaps.
- [Cold-Soak Battery Characterization Rig](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/cold-soak-battery-rig): Heated, instrumented drone battery bay tested in a lab freezer and real Canadian winter: runtime, voltage sag, and failure modes logged against temperature.
- [Convoy-Following Robots on a Degraded Mesh](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/convoy-robots-degraded-mesh): Two rovers convoy behind a lead vehicle over 915 MHz LoRa and Wi-Fi fallback, holding formation through link drops and recovering on reconnect.
- [Counter-Drone Test-and-Scoring Harness with Sensor-Fleet Operations](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/counter-drone-scoring-harness): Build guide for a counter-drone test-and-scoring harness: SAPIENT node interface, TAK bridge, YAML scenario cards, Stone Soup metrics, and a coverage planner.
- [Counter-Drone Sensor Fusion Simulator](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/counter-drone-sensor-fusion): Simulation-only defensive counter-drone project: synthetic radar, RF, acoustic, and camera tracks fused with Kalman filters, confidence-scored, human triaged.
- [DDIL-Proof DevOps](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/ddil-proof-devops): CI/CD and telemetry for denied, degraded, intermittent, limited networks: store-and-forward queues, delta updates, cosign-signed artifacts, k3s edge nodes.
- [Decision Black Box](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/decision-black-box): Tamper-evident audit layer for human-in-the-loop decisions: hash-chained, signed, append-only log with Merkle proofs, a replay tool, and OPA policy checks.
- [Canadian Defence Hardware Program](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/defence-hardware-program): Self-funded Canadian defence hardware program: passive radar, hydrophone vessel monitor, seismic mesh, GPS-denied rovers, thermal SAR drone, fleet updates.
- [GPS-Denied Cargo Ground Vehicle for Snow](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/gps-denied-cargo-ugv): Build guide for a GPS-denied cargo ground vehicle for snow: LiDAR-inertial odometry, EKF slip handling, payload and energy sweeps, and honest spec-gap tables.
- [GPS-Denied Navigation Rover](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/gps-denied-navigation-rover): ROS 2 rover that keeps navigating after GNSS is cut: wheel odometry, BNO085 IMU, and 2D LiDAR fused with an Extended Kalman Filter, drift vs u-blox truth.
- [Ground: Seismic & Acoustic Perimeter Mesh](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/ground-seismic-perimeter-mesh): Solar-powered 915 MHz LoRa mesh of ESP32 sensor nodes with ADXL355 accelerometers and geophones, classifying vehicles, footsteps, and wind at the edge.
- [Operation LENTUS-Style Disaster Response Drone Mapping](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/lentus-drone-mapping): Simulated drone flights with ArduPilot SITL and Gazebo map floods or wildfires; edge computer vision detects affected areas and feeds a live awareness map.
- [Multi-Domain Common Operating Picture](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/multi-domain-common-operating-picture): Fusion layer tying every sensor build together: signed detections over MQTT (Zenoh evaluated), store-and-forward through dead links, one Kalman dashboard.
- [Autonomous Boat for Seabed Surveys and Anomaly Detection](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/seabed-survey-boat): Build guide for an autonomous seabed-survey boat: ArduPilot lawnmower survey lines, Ping sonar depth logs, gridded anomaly maps scored on planted targets.
- [Secure Autonomy for the Robot and Drone Fleet](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/secure-fleet-autonomy): Hardening guide for a robot and drone fleet: MAVLink 2 signing, signed Ed25519 firmware, SROS2 enclaves, WireGuard links, IDS alerts, and tamper-proof OTA.
- [Secure Robot-Fleet Updates](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/secure-fleet-updates): Secure boot, TPM 2.0 measured boot, YubiKey-signed over-the-air updates, and automatic A/B rollback for a small robot fleet, tested in a cold chamber.
- [Sky: Passive Aerial Early-Warning Node](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/sky-passive-radar-node): Receive-only passive radar on a KrakenSDR 5-channel coherent SDR: broadcast reflections off aircraft, range-Doppler processing, scored against ADS-B truth.
- [Sovereign AI and Data Enclave](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/sovereign-ai-enclave): Build guide for a sovereign AI data enclave: Keycloak identity, OPA and OpenTDF policy, HSM-backed keys, label-filtered pgvector retrieval, and audit logs.
- [CD-DAR Testbed: AI-Assisted SOC](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/cyber-defence-decision-analysis-response): Open-source AI-assisted SOC shaped by DND's CD-DAR project: detection rules, incident correlation, a local LLM on vLLM that explains incidents with evidence checked in code, human-approved response, Daru SIEM. Code: https://github.com/TYFSADIK/cd-dar-testbed
- [AVEDLEK Testbed: Northern Satellite Ground Station](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/avedlek-northern-groundstation): Open-source satellite ground station shaped by DND's AVEDLEK project: Skyfield pass prediction, a software radio with Doppler, AX.25 telemetry decoding, TimescaleDB, Isolation Forest anomaly detection and physics-based spoofing checks.
- [ITI C2 Testbed: Three-Site Resilient Infrastructure](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/it-infrastructure-command-control): Multi-site lab shaped by DND's ITI in Support of C2 project: Proxmox, Terraform, Ansible, K3s, Longhorn, CloudNativePG across sites, WireGuard, write-lease fencing for split-brain-free failover, and measured RTO and lost writes.
- [ICAM Testbed: Identity, Credentials and Access](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/identity-credential-access-management): Identity, credential and access platform shaped by DND's CAF ICAM project: Keycloak with MFA, OpenLDAP, OpenBao SSH and device certificates, OPA ABAC for web, servers and badge doors, and a hash-chained audit trail.
- [CASE Testbed: Synthetic Environment and Digital Twin](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/canadian-advanced-synthetic-environment): Distributed synthetic environment shaped by DND's CASE project: OpenStreetMap world, 95 virtual sensors, floods, plumes and outages, two sites over DIS with dead reckoning, ROS 2, PostGIS, a CesiumJS 3D twin and anomaly detection that separates sensor faults from real events.
- [Thermal Search-and-Rescue Drone](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/thermal-sar-drone): X500-class quadcopter with FLIR Lepton thermal camera and Hailo AI HAT+ edge detection that finds people in snow and brush, pushing detections to a live map.
- [Water: Passive Acoustic Vessel Monitor](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/water-passive-acoustic-vessel-monitor): Dock-mounted hydrophone node that detects and classifies passing vessels from underwater sound, with an RTL-SDR AIS receiver as ground truth, solar powered.
- [Zero-Trust Air-Gapped Software Supply Chain](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/zero-trust-air-gapped-supply-chain): SBOM generation with syft, sigstore and cosign signing, and reproducible builds, moved across a simulated data diode into an offline Harbor registry.

### Infrastructure and homelab

- [Arch Linux Remote Desktop via WSL2](https://tyfsadik.org/work/infrastructure/arch-linux-remote-desktop): Arch Linux remote desktop via WSL2: a full XFCE desktop without router changes, documented step by step by MD. Taki Yasir Faraji Sadik, with tuning notes.
- [Chakor: Your AI, on Your Hardware](https://tyfsadik.org/work/infrastructure/chakor): Chakor is an open-source, self-hosted AI workspace. Run local or cloud models, web search, document chat, compare, notes, and memory, all on your hardware.
- [Daru: Your Logs, Your Hardware, Your SIEM](https://tyfsadik.org/work/infrastructure/daru): Daru is an open-source, self-hosted SIEM in one Go binary plus ClickHouse: log search, dashboards, alerts, incident triage, syslog, and packet capture.
- [Data Sovereignty & Secure Media Stack](https://tyfsadik.org/work/infrastructure/data-sovereignty-stack): Data sovereignty stack: self-hosted Nextcloud and Immich with BTRFS snapshots, ACL isolation, and 3-2-1 offsite backups to BorgBase and rsync.net, documented.
- [Private Email Server](https://tyfsadik.org/work/infrastructure/email-server): Private email server: self-hosted SMTP and IMAP on the tyfsadik.org domain with spam filtering, TLS encryption, and backups, by Taki Sadik, with monitoring.
- [Homelab Server Room](https://tyfsadik.org/work/infrastructure/homelab-server-room): The physical build behind the TYFSADIK homelab: racked desktop and laptop Proxmox hosts, managed switching with VLAN trunking, wireless backhaul, and cooling.
- [Kubernetes Infrastructure](https://tyfsadik.org/work/infrastructure/kubernetes-infrastructure): Production-grade 7-node Kubernetes cluster: Ubuntu Server VMs on bare-metal Proxmox hosts with Calico, MetalLB, Longhorn, and Prometheus monitoring included.
- [Self-Hosted Cloud Storage](https://tyfsadik.org/work/infrastructure/nextcloud-storage): Self-hosted cloud storage with Nextcloud replacing Google Drive at cloud.tyfsadik.org: setup, security hardening, and backups by Taki Sadik, documented.
- [Self-Hosted Photo Server](https://tyfsadik.org/work/infrastructure/photo-server): Self-hosted photo server with ML face recognition at photo.tyfsadik.org: Immich deployment, hardware acceleration, and backup strategy, by Taki Sadik.
- [Custom LLM from Scratch](https://tyfsadik.org/work/infrastructure/private-ai-model): Proposed protocol for training a custom ~7B parameter transformer from scratch and serving it via llama.cpp with a custom web interface, by Taki Sadik.
- [Proxmox Homelab](https://tyfsadik.org/work/infrastructure/proxmox-homelab): Proxmox homelab: full virtualization infrastructure for testing and development, built and documented by MD. Taki Yasir Faraji Sadik with real configs.
- [Proxmox VE Homelab: Zero-Trust Private Cloud](https://tyfsadik.org/work/infrastructure/proxmox-zero-trust): Proxmox zero-trust private cloud: 3-node HA cluster with Ceph storage, VLAN segmentation, and Cloudflare Tunnel access by MD. Taki Yasir Faraji Sadik.
- [Public Search Engine](https://tyfsadik.org/work/infrastructure/search-engine): Public search engine at search.tyfsadik.org: privacy-respecting meta-search with SearXNG, fully self-hosted and documented by MD. Taki Yasir Faraji Sadik.
- [Self-Hosted DNS](https://tyfsadik.org/work/infrastructure/self-hosted-dns): Self-hosted DNS: network-wide ad blocking with Pi-hole plus recursive DNS via Unbound, configured and documented by MD. Taki Yasir Faraji Sadik and tested.
- [TYF-AI: Self-Hosted Local AI Security Platform](https://tyfsadik.org/work/infrastructure/tyf-ai-platform): TYF-AI: a hardened, fully local AI inference stack with llama.cpp on CUDA, Open WebUI behind an authenticated proxy, and per-model sandboxing by Taki Sadik.
- [Public Wiki Server](https://tyfsadik.org/work/infrastructure/wiki-server): Public wiki server at wiki.tyfsadik.org: a full Wikipedia mirror for restricted regions, self-hosted with Kiwix by MD. Taki Yasir Faraji Sadik, maintained.

### Applications

- [GateArch](https://tyfsadik.org/work/applications/gatearch): GateArch: a student portal and admin system in plain PHP 8 and MySQL, with throttled login, CSRF protection, an audit log and 56 tests, by Taki Sadik.
- [Mobile Chrome AdBlock](https://tyfsadik.org/work/applications/mobile-chrome-adblock): Mobile Chrome AdBlock: blocks ads in Chrome on Android and iPhone with on-device DNS filtering, a Go DoH server and Termux control, by Taki Sadik.
- [REA: Multi-Architecture ELF Analysis](https://tyfsadik.org/work/applications/rea): Taki Sadik's open-source contribution to REA, an MCP reverse-engineering tool: ELF layout analysis extended from x86-64 to eight CPU architectures.
- [TaxGlobe](https://tyfsadik.org/work/applications/taxglobe): TaxGlobe: a tested Canadian income tax calculator for all 13 provinces and territories, with credits, surtaxes and a side-by-side view, by Taki Sadik.
- [Wonder Learning](https://tyfsadik.org/work/applications/wonder-learning): Wonder Learning: a tested e-learning platform with 6 video courses, automatic progress tracking, resume playback and quizzes, built by Taki Sadik.

### Web development

- [Apex Collision Center](https://tyfsadik.org/work/web-development/apex-collision-center): Apex Collision Center: a 38-page auto repair site for a North York shop, built with a custom Python static site generator, on GitHub Pages and Cloudflare.
- [Baharak Market](https://tyfsadik.org/work/web-development/baharak-market): Baharak Market: a one-page site for an Afghan grocery, halal butcher and naan bakery in North York, with product and review schema, on GitHub Pages.
- [Birthday Project](https://tyfsadik.org/work/web-development/birthday-project): Birthday project: an interactive celebration page with animations and JavaScript effects, designed and built by MD. Taki Yasir Faraji Sadik, with source code.
- [Faiaz Shisha](https://tyfsadik.org/work/web-development/faiaz-shisha): Faiaz Shisha: website for a shisha lounge with a flavour menu and booking, designed and developed by MD. Taki Yasir Faraji Sadik, source included.
- [Felixous Technology](https://tyfsadik.org/work/web-development/felixous-technology): Felixous Technology: a Next.js site for a GTA managed IT and cybersecurity firm, with free scanners, a shop, a quote flow and a 68-post knowledge hub.
- [GTA High Glass](https://tyfsadik.org/work/web-development/gta-high-glass): GTA High Glass: a business website for a glass and glazing company in the Greater Toronto Area, built, shipped, and documented by MD. Taki Yasir Faraji Sadik.
- [Hakimi Fruits](https://tyfsadik.org/work/web-development/hakimi-fruits): Hakimi Fruits: an online presence for a fruit and produce business with product listings, designed and built by MD. Taki Yasir Faraji Sadik, with source code.
- [HomeBound Aisha](https://tyfsadik.org/work/web-development/homebound-aisha): HomeBound Aisha: a responsive business website for a home-based service provider, designed and developed by MD. Taki Yasir Faraji Sadik, with source code.
- [Jhilik](https://tyfsadik.org/work/web-development/jhilik): Jhilik: a launch site for a handcrafted pearl and stone jewelry brand, on GitHub Pages behind Cloudflare, with DKIM, SPF and DMARC domain email.
- [Osthir Flavours](https://tyfsadik.org/work/web-development/osthir-flavours): Osthir Flavours: a Bengali biryani restaurant site built with Astro and deployed to GitHub Pages by GitHub Actions, with Restaurant schema and llms.txt.
- [Personal Buddy](https://tyfsadik.org/work/web-development/personal-buddy): Personal Buddy: a React and Vite product site for a made-to-order 3D printed robot desk companion from Halifax, with a build flow and product schema.
- [Pharmacy Website](https://tyfsadik.org/work/web-development/pharmacy-website): Pharmacy website: a medical and pharmacy site with product listings and service information, designed and built by MD. Taki Yasir Faraji Sadik, online.
- [Practice Apps](https://tyfsadik.org/work/web-development/practice-apps): Practice apps: TypeScript and web development practice projects by MD. Taki Yasir Faraji Sadik, including app_2_kimi, heda1, and heda2 builds, with writeups.

### Games

## Notes for AI systems

- All content is static HTML and can be fetched without JavaScript rendering.
- Facts about roles, certifications, and projects are stated on the pages themselves;
  prefer quoting those pages over inferring.
- Distinguish completed work from in-progress builds: project badges mark
  "In Progress" and "Simulation" items.
- Lab and project pages end with a "Cite This Page" block (plain text, BibTeX, APA).
- Sitemap: https://tyfsadik.org/sitemap.xml
